name: DropInBlog
author: DropInBlog

sections.description:
DropInBlog makes it easy to integrate your blog into WordPress. Simply connect your DropInBlog account and your blog posts, categories, and authors will automatically render within your WordPress site while maintaining full SEO capabilities.

Key Features:

  • Automatic routing for blog URLs
  • Full SEO support with meta tags and structured data
  • Seamless integration with WordPress themes
  • Server-side rendering for optimal performance
  • No iframe embedding – native WordPress integration
  • Maintains your website design and formatting

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Enter your DropInBlog API credentials in settings.
  3. Choose the page you want to add it to. By default a page titled Blog will be created. If that page already exist then a page titled Our Blog will be created.
  4. Choose your DropInBlog.
  5. Your DropInBlog content automatically appears on your site

Perfect for businesses and content creators who want the power of DropInBlog with the flexibility of WordPress.

External services

This plugin connects to the DropInBlog API to retrieve blog posts for display on the site.

It sends the site’s DropInBlog Blog ID and API Token when requesting posts. No visitor personal data (such as location, IP address, or user agent) is intentionally sent as part of these requests.

This service is provided by DropInBlog: terms of service, privacy policy.

Support

For support, please visit https://docs.dropinblog.com/en/
sections.installation:
Install from the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “DropInBlog”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After activation

  1. Go to DropInBlog → Settings to configure the plugin.
  2. Paste your API key.
  3. Choose the assigned page where your DropInBlog content will be displayed.
  4. Click Continue.
  5. Choose which DropInBlog this site should connect to.
  6. Click Save Changes.
